done_when: When the tests close would pick cover more than a third of the suite, close skips the local run, says so in one line, and relies on the pull request's required checks

findings.body: Raise: Test. The large-selection cases always make the required `tests` check fail, so they prove only that a red check stops close. No case shows that a skipped local run reaches Ready when required checks pass. No case configures checks without `tests` and verifies that close runs pytest locally instead of skipping it. Regressions in either outcome would pass these tests, leaving the required-check reliance unproven.
findings.title: Not done: test green-check completion and the missing-tests-check safeguard

why: When a change touches many files, close's local tests turn into the full suite, which takes about an hour on a laptop while GitHub runs it anyway
